system.description: There's always a risk that someone you deal with will try to turn on you. After successfully charming, deceiving, interacting positively with, or using Fast Talk or a similar ability on a creature, if they become hostile to you within a day or so, you automatically reduce the wound severity of their first successful attack against you by one step. Enabler. At tier 3: Instead of reducing the wound's severity, you ignore it completely (no damage).
